title: NearbyEncryptedEnvelope v2
description: Plaintext of each ChaChaPoly frame. The binary frame around it is: magic 'TBCH' | version u8 = 1 | direction u8 (1 origin->recipient, 2 recipient->origin) | sequence u64 BE | AEAD ciphertext, AAD = header + transcript hash. The frame version bumps only together with the protocol version. DEBUG builds add a 'test' kind that never ships. Frozen for protocol version 2.

payload.description: base64; per-kind payload, e.g. the encoded BootstrapManifest for kind 'manifest'
